title.en: Start an execution and read its status as it advances

goal.en: Send the example ExecuteRequest to the reference hub with a person in the kitchen, then read the status a few seconds later and see the sequence number and the first step that needs a person.

note.en: Read the capability document of the device behind the hub: one counter arm that cuts, cracks and transfers, with a vision sensor and no heat source.
Start the example request for shakshuka. The hub dry-runs the recipe first and answers with an ExecutionStatus at seq 0 that carries the plan.
The hub used by the runner simulates time at 200x. The arm dices the onion, pepper and tomato, then reaches the first step a person must perform.
Read the status: seq has advanced (the ETag header carries the same number) and the device waits for a person to heat the pan.
The status names the request it answers; the recipe reference and hash are in that request and in the execution log.

cli: jq '. + {"x-hub-human-present": true}' examples/core/execute-request.json | curl -s -X POST http://localhost:7878/v1/executions -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -H 'Idempotency-Key: ex-2026-10-04-001-a' -d @-

outcome.en: You have started a run, read its status and seen that a device with no heat source hands heating to the person present. Next: scenario 041 stops a run and reads its log; 042 resumes one.
